headline: GTBTC contract discovery incomplete due to pinned chain mismatch and missing deployment documentation

findings.text: Block explorer name-tag search skipped: pinned chain is 'Bitcoin' but GTBTC is deployed on EVM chains (Ethereum, BSC, Base, Solana). Bitcoin has no smart contract layer.

Official deployments doc not found: proof-of-reserve page confirms multi-chain deployment but lists no contract addresses by chain. Proof page URL https://www.gate.com/proof-of-reserve/gtbtc does not expose queryable addresses.
Audit PDFs not recorded in protocol pins; audit_links field is empty. Proof of reserves page mentions 'Audit Report' link but fetch did not expose audit URL.

GitHub repo https://github.com/gatechain/gtbtc located; branch evm-gt-btc examined. No hardhat-deploy/ or broadcast/ artifacts directory visible; no addresses.json or deployments.json found in repo listing.

Multi-chain enumeration blocked: protocol pinned to 'Bitcoin' (non-EVM) but documentation lists 5 chains (Ethereum, BSC, Base, Solana, ABS). Chain mismatch prevents systematic per-chain address discovery.
Factory discovery deferred: no factory contracts identified in accessible documentation.
Role taxonomy: 'owner', 'admin', 'rate_controller', 'blacklister', 'minter' roles identified in GitHub contract code inspection, but no addresses assigned to discovered roles.

Ratchet output incomplete: EVM contract address 0xc2d09cf86b9ff43cb29ef8ddca57a4eb4410d5f3 and Solana address gtBTCGWvSRYYoZpU9UZj6i3eUGUpgksXzzsbHk2K9So cited in third-party analysis; no primary Gate source pins chain/role. Solana address format indicates non-EVM address type.

rationale.verdict: Chain specification mismatch blocks systematic discovery. GTBTC is an EVM token but protocol pinned to Bitcoin (non-EVM). Missing deployed_contracts_doc with per-chain addresses, missing audit_links, and no on-chain addresses discoverable from GitHub artifacts. Without re-pinning to actual deployment chains (Ethereum, BSC, Base, Solana), block-explorer name-tag searches cannot proceed. Recommend protocol context update before next assessment run.

evidence.shows: GTBTC is a yield-bearing wrapped BTC token. Describes minting, redemption, and cross-chain deployment but does not list contract addresses.

Confirms multi-chain deployment on Ethereum, BNB Smart Chain, Base, and Solana. Supply distribution section present but no contract addresses displayed. References open-source contract code at https://github.com/gatechain/gtbtc.
GTBTC landing page describes product features, staking mechanics, and benefits. Confirms cross-chain wrapping and DeFi integration but does not enumerate contract addresses per chain.

GitHub repository for GTBTC smart contracts. Branch 'evm-gt-btc' indicates EVM deployment code. Hardhat config and package.json present; no hardhat-deploy or Foundry broadcast artifacts listing deployed addresses visible in repo root or subdirectories.

Gate analysis article mentions contract addresses on EVM chains (0xc2d09cf86b9ff43cb29ef8ddca57a4eb4410d5f3) and Solana (gtBTCGWvSRYYoZpU9UZj6i3eUGUpgksXzzsbHk2K9So). States GTBTC deployed across 'five different blockchain networks (BSC, ETH, BASE, SOL, ABS)' but does not cite which address applies to which chain.

unknowns: D1: Block-explorer search deferred—protocol pinned to 'Bitcoin' chain but GTBTC is EVM token. Bitcoin mainnet has no smart contracts.
D2: Deployed contracts documentation not located—proof-of-reserves page lacks address table or per-chain manifest.
D3: Audit PDFs not indexed—protocol.audit_links empty; 'Audit Report' link on proof-of-reserve page not fetched.
D4: GitHub deployment artifacts not found—no hardhat-deploy, Foundry broadcast, or addresses.json in repo listing.
D5-offchain: Chain mismatch blocks systematic D5 enumeration—pinned 'Bitcoin' vs. actual EVM+Solana deployment prevents per-chain block-explorer searches.
D6: Factory-discovered children not enumerable without factory address discovery.
D8: Unknown mapping of 0xc2d09cf86b9ff43cb29ef8ddca57a4eb4410d5f3 and gtBTCGWvSRYYoZpU9UZj6i3eUGUpgksXzzsbHk2K9So to chains—Gate analysis article does not specify which address for which chain.

protocol_metadata.about: GTBTC is Gate's yield-bearing wrapped Bitcoin token, minted by staking BTC on Gate's platform. Users stake BTC to receive GTBTC, which accrues on-chain rewards and can be redeemed for BTC anytime. GTBTC is deployed across multiple EVM chains (Ethereum, BSC, Base) and Solana, enabling DeFi use cases such as lending, trading, and collateral.
